papers.decisive_ablation: A.3 isolates CAM against Add-Cond/Conc-Cond; A.3.2 compares CAM with/without APM. A.3.3 isolates blending from shared noise.

papers.venue_evidence: CVF official proceedings author/title/booktitle/year, PDF ICCV watermark

papers.decisive_ablation: Table4 compares temporal/camera-distance/FOV/surfel retrieval inside each fixed K group. Table1 explicitly has identical short-horizon K17 outputs when context fits.

candidate.type: New Setting / falsifiable diagnostic, not validated new method
candidate.question: Can geometry-retrieved references harm return-view appearance through their pooled semantic direction, conditional on identical ordered latents, cameras and selected information?
candidate.status: UNTESTED; NOT PREREGISTERED; NOT AUTHORIZED AS A SCIENTIFIC RUN BY THIS DOCUMENT
candidate.source_fact: Original get_cond averages selected CLIP encoder_embeddings on dim0 at1125 and repeats at1150. Producer latent replace and ray/camera conditioning are separate unchanged paths.
interventions: A selected previously observed anchor vector, scaled to the norm of the original mean
The selected nearest-camera vector, scaled to the norm of the original mean
input_gates: All selected contexts and cached quantities come from original real generation; no fake latent
Anchor must already be in lawful selected set; otherwise retain preselected unit as ineligible/NA without expanding information
Nonzero finite norms and unchanged unconditional inputs; failure means intervention unidentifiable, not a positive result
Same parameters, resolution, steps, noise, pose/intrinsics, latent bytes and ordered contexts; change semantic direction only
candidate.minimal_design: Only after actual original baseline passes: at least two preselected new physical scenes with paired preset seeds; one natural return request per unit and three matched sampling calls. Exact scene/seed count, joint acceptance margin and runtime cap must be frozen before outputs; no current sample-size/power claim.
candidate.endpoints: Same-view observed-content reconstruction plus requested-view adherence; never treat constant copied frames as success. Report all units and missing reasons; not solely CLIP or geometry error.
candidate.baseline_interpretation: Anchor and nearest-vector routes are ordinary strong controls. If either solves the effect, stop at baseline hardening; no new name or novelty claim.
stop_conditions: Original full resources or execution gate absent => not testable
No natural eligible exposure => do not force a failure or alter candidate-count rules
No stable paired gain across scenes/seeds or camera adherence worsens => reject benefit version or report uncertainty under frozen margins
Effects require altered norm, additional frames, GT-based choice, changed focal/latents or post-hoc selection => causal claim invalid
Ordinary anchor/nearest control explains benefit => reject novel-method positioning
